description: fern-hearth visible expectation: after a correct solve, /app/deployed/main exactly mirrors the main branch tree of /app/repo.git (README.md, index.html, assets/site.css), /app/normalize_url.py exists and is runnable, and /app/paper_links.json + /app/urls.tsv map every paper in /app/papers/index.html to its official canonical repository URL.
checks: main branch deployed as exact mirror under /app/deployed/main
pushed branch trees mirrored byte-for-byte under /app/deployed/<branch>
branch deletion removes its served directory
non-branch refs create no deployment entries and do not abort pushes
in-place branch updates replace the served tree
normalize_url.py returns canonical forms on hidden trailing-slash/query/port/fragment/malformed inputs
paper_links.json id set equals the index paper set with correct official repo urls (empty for unresolvable)
urls.tsv holds exactly the canonical resolved repo urls
